BarChartBlock.description: A bar chart of labeled numeric series (verified figures only).
BarChartBlock.title: BarChartBlock

BarPointDTO.description: One bar of a comparable chart; an N/A/absent point carries no value.
BarPointDTO.title: BarPointDTO

ClarificationBlock.description: A clarification prompt (carries a question, no unverified numbers).
ClarificationBlock.title: ClarificationBlock

ComparisonRowDTO.description: One metric compared across parts, with comparability and context.
ComparisonRowDTO.title: ComparisonRowDTO

ComparisonTableBlock.description: A comparison table across parts/attributes (verified figures only).
ComparisonTableBlock.title: ComparisonTableBlock

ConversationTurnRequest.description:
``POST /api/conversation`` body: optional session id + required query.

``client_request_id`` is the idempotency key (Property 15). ``extra`` is
ignored so a client cannot smuggle an ``owner_id`` (Property 10).
ConversationTurnRequest.title: ConversationTurnRequest

CriterionDTO.description: One criterion of an interpretation summary with exactly one category.
CriterionDTO.title: CriterionDTO

EnvelopeStatus.description:
Optional turn ``status`` for a ``Response_Envelope``.

Mirrors the design: completion plus clarification/confirmation states.
EnvelopeStatus.title: EnvelopeStatus

EvidenceDTO.description: The published source cells/rows/notes a figure resolves to.
EvidenceDTO.title: EvidenceDTO

FigureDTO.description: One verified figure (or explicit absence) with its full context.
FigureDTO.title: FigureDTO

InterpretationSummaryDTO.description: The always-visible interpretation of a turn (no internals leaked).
InterpretationSummaryDTO.title: InterpretationSummaryDTO

MatchingPartNumbersBlock.description: Matching part numbers with a total and a (paginated) list.
MatchingPartNumbersBlock.title: MatchingPartNumbersBlock

MeResponse.description: ``GET /api/auth/me`` body — identity and role, never secret material.
MeResponse.title: MeResponse

PlanRef.description: A plan reference carried by the envelope when a plan is in play.
PlanRef.title: PlanRef

PlanReviewBlock.description: A plan-review block surfacing a plan revision for confirmation.
PlanReviewBlock.title: PlanReviewBlock

ProductCardBlock.description: A single product/part summary card. Figures are verified upstream.
ProductCardBlock.title: ProductCardBlock

RefreshRequest.description:
Refresh payload carrying the presented refresh token string.

The token may also be presented via the ``Authorization`` header; the body
form is accepted for non-browser clients.
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

RegisterRequest.description:
Registration payload: email + password only.

``extra="ignore"`` drops any unexpected field (including an injected
``role``/privilege field) so it never reaches the use case.
RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest

RenameRequest.description: ``PATCH /api/sessions/{id}`` body: a new title (validated in the service).
RenameRequest.title: RenameRequest

ResponseEnvelope.description:
The mandatory response envelope (design: Response_Envelope).

The inviolable contract is a non-empty ``session_id`` and a non-empty
``answer``. All other fields are optional and typed. ``content_blocks`` is
the structural discriminated union above. The envelope never carries a
``model`` name, tool name, prompt, or any secret.
ResponseEnvelope.title: ResponseEnvelope

SessionSummaryResponse.description: A ``GET /api/sessions`` listing entry (title decrypted after authorize).
SessionSummaryResponse.title: SessionSummaryResponse

TextBlock.description: Plain conversational text. The universal safe fallback block.
TextBlock.title: TextBlock

TokenPairResponse.description: The issued access+refresh token pair returned to the client once.
TokenPairResponse.title: TokenPairResponse

UserResponse.description:
Registration result and ``/me`` body: identity + role only.

Contains NO password hash, token secret, or verifier (Property 9).
UserResponse.title: UserResponse

UserRole.description:
Account role. ``developer`` is a Debug capability over the developer's
OWN resources only — never a superuser (design: Authorization guard).
UserRole.title: UserRole

Register a new account (role ``user``, assigned server-side).
Run a mandatory sync turn; always returns a non-empty envelope.
Accept an async turn job (``202``/``QUEUED``); never substitutes sync.

get.description:
Return readiness, distinguishing database from other dependencies.

Distinguishes **database** availability from **other critical
dependencies** — key material and the LLM **provider** (Property 49). A
degraded dependency is reported as a ``False`` flag so the process stays up
and surfaces the degradation rather than crashing. Overall readiness
requires the database and key material; a degraded *provider* is reported
but does not, on its own, crash the service (the sync turn surfaces
``UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`` honestly).
List the caller's conversations (optional owner-scoped title search).

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Sessions Get

delete.description: Delete a conversation: tombstone, purge, crypto-shred (204).

get.description: Return the owner's messages + typed blocks in deterministic order.

schema.title: Response Get Messages Api Sessions  Session Id  Messages Get

get.description: Return a sanitized trace to a developer-owner, else an identical denial.

post.description:
Confirm the current plan revision; idempotent, owner-only.

The first confirmation of the current revision triggers its single
execution through the agent seam (after the confirmation committed); a
repeated confirmation executes nothing (Property 29, Spec 4 Req 6.5).

schema.title: Response Confirm Plan Api Sessions  Session Id  Plans  Revision  Confirm Post
